photo.alt: Andromica glasswing photographed from the side on white flowers in Mindo, Ecuador; transparent panels, ivory bands, and brown borders are visible

habitat: Humid Andean forests, including the Mindo area
wingspan: small clearwing; varies by sex and form
hostPlants: Not verified for this Ecuador record
identification: Transparent wing panels, warm brown borders, and pale patches near the tips.
fact: Tiny bristle-like scales help create transparent wing areas, while other scales form pale marks.
form: Representative clearwing; photographed individual shown from the side

source.title: Florida Museum of Natural History · Ecuador rearing records

elevation: Ecuador study sites: 1,000–2,700 m; not a full species range
fieldNotes: Clear panels let the background show through the wings.
Bristle-like scales differ from the broad scales on opaque areas.
Florida Museum records this species from Ecuadorian Andean study sites.
reflection: Where did you notice light passing through something today?
